description: Concept graph extracted from a chunk of lecture pages.

concepts.description: Key concepts taught in these pages. Skip trivia, examples without a name, and administrative text.

id.description: Short lowercase slug, unique within this response, e.g. 'binary-search-tree'.

name.description: Concept name as a student would say it.

definition.description: One or two sentences, using only what the pages say.

importance.description: core = a main idea of this topic; supporting = detail or helper idea.

pages.description: Page numbers where the concept is explained. Use the numbers from the [[PAGE n]] markers only.

relations.description: Directed links between concepts, each supported by the text.

source_id.description: id of the concept the relation starts from.

target_id.description: id of the concept the relation points to.

type.description: prerequisite_of: source must be understood before target. part_of: source is a component of target. example_of: source is an instance of target. contrasts_with: the pages compare them. related_to: only if none of the others fit.

explanation.description: One short sentence saying why they are linked.

page.description: Page number that supports this link, from the [[PAGE n]] markers.
